name: Cell-balancing board
description: Passive or active balancer connected to the cell taps of a pack, controlled by a BMS or standalone.
electrical_characteristics: Passive: bleed resistor and switch per cell
Active: switched capacitor or transformer transfer between cells
critical_electrical_constraints: Balance resistor dissipation continuous at the top-of-charge voltage
Cell taps protected against mis-insertion and ESD
Traces to taps sized for the balance current
stackup_recommendations: 2 layers for single-cell boards; 4 layers with a solid ground for multi-cell monitors with precision sensing
2 oz copper on the charge/discharge path above ~3 A
placement_rules: Charger IC thermal pad with via array; input capacitor at the input pin; battery-side capacitor at the BAT pin
Protection MOSFETs and the current-sense resistor on the cell negative path with a Kelvin sense pair
NTC thermistor placed to track cell temperature (connector or pack lead), not board heat
Cell-tap connectors ordered so that mis-insertion is mechanically impossible
routing_rules: Charge/discharge path width from IPC-2221 for the peak current
Kelvin routing of the sense resistor: sense traces from the pad inner edges
Cell-tap traces with series resistors at the entry for balancing current and ESD
Keep the thermistor and fuel-gauge sense traces away from switching nodes
copper_ground_requirements: Pack negative as a polygon; sense ground star-connected at the sense resistor
No pour under the fuel gauge's sense pins
thermal_considerations: Charger dissipation at maximum input voltage and charge current; linear chargers above 0.5 A need copper area per the datasheet
Balancing resistors dissipate continuously during balance: derate
emi_emc_considerations: Switching chargers follow the DC-DC hot-loop rules
protection_requirements: Over-charge, over-discharge, over-current and short-circuit protection by a dedicated protection IC; the charger alone is not protection
Reverse battery connection protection where the pack is user-connectable
Thermal protection with a cell-mounted NTC
verification_requirements: Charge current and cell chemistry declared; charge voltage matches chemistry (never assumed)
Trace widths and sense-resistor Kelvin verified
Protection thresholds recorded with the datasheet source
Pack safety (IEC 62133-2 / UL 2054) is a certification item, not an offline check
manufacturing_constraints: Connector choice with keying; label polarity on silkscreen
Sense resistor footprint sized for Kelvin pads
unsupported_conditions: Balance current above the tap wiring rating
